name: Swoop Gizzard
summary: A swoop gizzard is an organ harvested from the predatory birds soaring over Mulgore. Highly sought after for traditional folk remedies, it serves as a crucial ingredient for cleansing deadly toxins.

sections.title: A Rare Folk Ingredient
sections.body: Swoops are predatory avian hunters native to the plains and mesas of Mulgore, known for their keen eyesight and scavenging nature. While their feathers and meat serve everyday uses for the tauren, their internal organs—particularly the gizzard—are prized by herbalists and healers. When combined with other potent animal remnants like cougar bones and wolf hearts, the dense muscular organ aids in neutralizing venomous animal bites and halting festering systemic infections.

sections.title: A Remedy for Mazzranache's Bite
sections.body: In Bloodhoof Village, the medicine worker Maur Raincaller fell prey to the legendary plainstrider Mazzranache, suffering a vicious, venomous wound to his shoulder. Falling into delirium from the creeping poison, Maur relies on a swoop gizzard alongside a prairie wolf heart, a flatland cougar femur, and a plainstrider scale to concoct a curative poultice capable of expelling the beast's lethal venom.

faq.q: What is a swoop gizzard used for?
aliases: why do i need swoop gizzard
faq.answer: It is an essential medicinal ingredient required by Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village. Combined with three other animal parts, it forms a remedy capable of cleansing the venomous infection caused by the vicious plainstrider Mazzranache.

faq.q: Where do swoop gizzards come from?
faq.answer: They are harvested from the various species of swoops gliding across the plains of Mulgore, including standard swoops, wiry swoops, and taloned swoops.

faq.q: Why does Maur Raincaller need this specific part?
faq.answer: Maur was bitten by Mazzranache, an unusually ferocious plainstrider whose bite delivers venom that causes raging fevers and nightmares. Traditional tauren medicine utilizes potent animal components—including the gizzard—to counteract the specific toxins running through his veins.

faq.q: Is the gizzard used for anything other than Maur's cure?
faq.answer: No. Outside of Maur Raincaller's specialized folk remedy in Bloodhoof Village, swoop gizzards have no standard culinary, alchemical, or crafting applications.

angles.text: For tauren hunters and shamans, collecting such parts honors the tradition of using every piece of Mulgore's wildlife to sustain and heal the tribe.
